active_disasters_and_trials.name: The Unregulated Atmospheric Squall
active_disasters_and_trials.threat: Collapse of unfinished timber framing; water damage to quarried lime.
active_disasters_and_trials.human_trial: Requires all participants to hold the guy-lines and brace the pillars in freezing rain for 4 hours without automated weather domes.
